headword: {入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}

definitions.gloss: no admittance; entry prohibited; a sign or rule forbidding people from entering a venue or area
definitions.explanation: no admittance; entry prohibited; a sign or rule forbidding people from entering a venue or area

examples.japanese: {入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{未成年者|みせいねんしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}です。
examples.english: Minors are not permitted to enter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}{中|ちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: Due to construction work, entry beyond this point is prohibited.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧ (entry to a venue) and ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (prohibition). Commonly seen on signs at construction sites, restricted areas, event venues, and establishments with age or dress code restrictions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}⟦{区域|くいき}→区域：00251_kuiki⟧ — restricted entry area
- ⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦{以外|いがい}→以外：01297_igai⟧{入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし} — authorized personnel only
- {入場|にゅうじょう}{禁止|きんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to be barred from entry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}→立入禁止：09542_tachiirikinshi⟧ — no trespassing (broader; for outdoor areas, not just venues)
- {出入|でいり}り⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ — banned from entering (often a permanent ban on a person)
- ⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧ — entry restriction (limits rather than a total ban)
